title: Mailflare Cloud — Business Email, Drive, Calendar & Booking
excerpt: Business email, Drive, calendar & booking on your own domain from $2.98/user. High-deliverability sending & 7-day free trial—75% less than Google Workspace.
content_html:
Modern Workspace with AI agents

High-deliverability business email with Drive, Calendar, Booking, and AI agents built-in — without per-seat pricing.

Get started

7-day free trial · Custom domains included · Cancel anytime

How it works

Step 1

Create an account and name your workspace. It takes a minute.

Step 2

Try any plan free for 7 days. Switch or cancel whenever you like.

Step 3

Connect to your domain and your own separate space is ready to use

Everything included

Professional emails, Drive, Calendar and allow client to book with you with one simple workspace and one simple bill.

01 · Email

Send and receive from up to 100 of your own domains. Share inboxes with your team, create as many nicknames as you need, and let built-in spam protection keep junk out. Your messages are set up to reach the main inbox, not spam.

02 · Calendar & booking

Share calendars, send invites and reminders, and let clients book time with you on a page with your own web address. All next to your inbox, so there is no separate scheduling tool to pay for.

03 · Files

Upload, organize and share files with your team from the same place as your email. Your files are kept in storage that belongs only to your team.

04 · Automation & AI

Use the built-in AI assistant to sort and draft replies. Connect your favorite mail apps and other tools to automate repetitive tasks.

AI assistant · Automations · Mail apps

Assistant · Sort my inbox

→ Summarize unread client emails

→ Draft reply + add booking link

✓ Domain verified · Ready to send

Why teams switch

We guide you through proving your emails really come from you, and we watch for misuse that could hurt your reputation. That helps your messages land in the main inbox instead of spam.

Every team gets a separate space for its mail, calendars and files. Nothing is ever mixed with other customers' data.

Security fixes and new features arrive automatically, with no downtime. Nothing to install or maintain.

One sign-in gives your whole team email, files, calendar and booking, with no extra charges for scheduling tools or more storage.

Simple pricing

Every plan includes all apps and a 7-day free trial. Cancel anytime.

Save ~$1,630/year for a 10-person team

Google Workspace + Calendly costs ~$17/user/mo ($170/mo for 10 people). Mailflare Cloud includes email, Drive, calendar & booking from $2.98/user/mo ($34/mo for 10 people).

FAQ

Is this different from Mailflare?+

It is the same open-source Mailflare, fully run for you. We handle the setup, reliable email delivery, billing and updates, so you just use it.

How do you make sure my emails don't end up in spam?+

For every domain, we use a high-deliverability email provider for email sending, walk you through the simple settings that prove your emails really come from you. We also limit unusual sending and filter spam, which protects your reputation so real business emails reach the inbox.

Who sees my mail and Drive files?+

Nobody outside your workspace. Each workspace has its own separate space for mail and files, so one team can never see another's.

Can I use my own domain?+

Yes. Add up to 100 of your own domains, depending on your plan, and we show you exactly what to set up. Sending and receiving then work automatically.

How do upgrades work?+

New features and security fixes reach every workspace automatically. There is nothing for you to do.

What happens if payment fails or I cancel?+

You get a grace period with reminders to update your payment details before the workspace pauses. After cancelling, or if the problem isn't fixed, we keep your data for 7 days so you can get it back before it is permanently deleted.

How do I change plan or cancel?+

Change plan, update your payment method or cancel anytime from the billing page or your workspace settings. Your limits update automatically.

How does the free trial work?+

Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial. During the trial you can add 1 domain, and each person can send 20 emails a day. This protects email quality for everyone. Both limits lift to your plan's full numbers when the trial ends.

Start your 7-day free trial. Your workspace is ready in minutes, and you can cancel anytime.
